---
name: Research method or example
about: Propose a decision pattern, coverage improvement or worked example
labels: enhancement
---

## Decision this improves

Task/outcome, constraints, greenfield or brownfield, and cost of getting it wrong.

## Run context

Prior Art version/commit, runtime/model versions, tools available and research budget.
If this is a proposal rather than a completed run, say so.

## Evidence and counterexample

Source URL or self-contained fixture, pinned version/commit, exact locator and retrieval
date. Label synthetic evidence explicitly. State source ancestry/independence and
which claims are observed versus inferred. Include a competing pattern or limitation.

## Proposed change

What should Prior Art do differently? Where would it live? What remains out of scope?

## Reproducible verification

Sanitized prompt/input, expected decision behavior and failure signals. Distinguish
checks already run from checks proposed. Include coverage failures and exclusions.

## Privacy and reuse

- [ ] No private project records, customer details, secret links or credentials included.
- [ ] Attribution/license requirements considered for any copied material.
- [ ] Evidence limitations and synthetic observations are clearly labeled.
